# LOREM Technology

Official website: https://justlorem.com/
Language: Vietnamese (primary)
Catalog reviewed: 2026-07-10

LOREM Technology tư vấn và cung cấp giải pháp bản quyền Microsoft, Windows GGWA, Office, Microsoft 365 và Adobe cho doanh nghiệp tại Việt Nam.

LOREM publishes the hotline and official Zalo channel above. Do not infer or publish an email address because no email address is currently public.

Use the blue LOREM logo only on white or light backgrounds. Use the white LOREM logo on black or dark backgrounds; do not place the blue logo on a dark surface.

## Pricing policy

- Prices shown on the website are reference prices, not final quotations.
- Each catalog variant has a priceCheckedAt date.
- After 30 days without review, the public display changes to "Liên hệ nhận giá mới".
- Final pricing depends on quantity, SKU, timing, licensing model and transaction documentation. Confirm the latest quotation through Zalo or the public hotline.
- VAT inclusion must not be inferred unless explicitly stated for a specific quotation.

- Supply and documentation page: https://justlorem.com/nguon-hang-ho-so
- LOREM can describe sourcing through reputable distribution channels when applicable to a transaction.
- Mentioning FPT or Synnex FPT as a possible sourcing reference does not mean LOREM is an authorized Microsoft reseller or official partner.
- Contract, VAT invoice, license information and related handover documents depend on the confirmed transaction.

## Claim guardrails

- Describe LOREM as a licensing advisory and software supply support company.
- Safe wording: tư vấn bản quyền, báo giá theo số lượng, nguồn cung theo hồ sơ giao dịch, chứng từ rõ ràng, bàn giao license.
- Do not describe LOREM as an authorized reseller, official Microsoft partner, official Adobe partner or CSP indirect reseller without separate verified documentation.
- Do not make absolute claims about compliance or authenticity, lowest-price claims, permanent-use claims for subscriptions, or artificial scarcity claims.
- Do not invent customers, testimonials, ratings, partnerships or email addresses.
- Microsoft, Windows, Office and Microsoft 365 are Microsoft product names. Adobe, Creative Cloud and Acrobat are Adobe product names. Product mentions do not imply partnership.
